name: kraken-trades
purpose: Every trade Kraken's WebSocket v2 trade channel sent the capture: the frames exactly as read (bronze_trade), and one typed row per trade and delivery (silver_trade) with the instrument its symbol names, every delivery kept and a repeat of a trade id flagged, never dropped.
limitations: Only frames the capture received are here; a capture outage is a hole in time, not in offsets, and the offset checks cannot see it. A trade whose symbol the security master does not resolve at the trade's time is held in silver_trade_unresolved, owner-only, and missing from silver_trade until the master resolves it; the audit unresolved_rows_zero then warns and the product shows degraded. Every delivery is a row: a reader counting trades filters is_duplicate false. The venue's terms of reuse are not yet recorded here: the owner confirms them before any grant outside the owning team (k2gen check refuses such a grant while no terms are recorded).
usage: Read market_capture.kraken_trades.silver_trade, one row per trade and delivery keyed by (kafka_partition, kafka_offset, trade_ordinal, trade_ts); is_duplicate false keeps each trade once, its first delivery by offset. bronze_trade and silver_trade_unresolved are the owning team's.

outputs.purpose: One row per record of the raw Kraken topic whose envelope stream is trade, its RawMessage envelope decoded by the frame's writer schema id (I-1, 2026-11-28: Trino decodes no Avro, so silver reads these columns, never the frame's bytes, which stay in the landing): staged from lake.kraken_trades.landing by offset, so a retry or a kill between the landing commit and the stage adds no row twice and leaves no hole. The connector's audit (accounting, parses, keys_unique) passes before a batch publishes; parses fails a frame whose writer schema lacks an envelope column or types it otherwise, naming the column.

columns.name: kafka_partition
columns.description: The topic partition; with kafka_offset, the row's lineage to the landing and the topic.

columns.name: kafka_offset
columns.description: The record's offset in its partition.

columns.name: kafka_timestamp
columns.description: The record's Kafka timestamp, set when the capture produced it.

columns.name: schema_id
columns.description: The frame's Confluent writer schema id, the registry's id for the RawMessage version that wrote it; null for a record that is not Confluent-framed, which the audit's parses fails.

columns.name: exchange
columns.description: RawMessage.exchange, the venue identifier, decoded by the writer schema.

columns.name: stream
columns.description: RawMessage.stream, the subscription the frame arrived on; trade for every row the filter kept.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: RawMessage.symbol, the instrument as the venue spells it; null for a frame of no single instrument.

columns.name: recv_ts_ns
columns.description: RawMessage.recv_ts_ns, the capture's receive time, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

columns.name: conn_id
columns.description: RawMessage.conn_id, the WebSocket connection the frame arrived on.

columns.name: conn_msg_seq
columns.description: RawMessage.conn_msg_seq, the capture's counter of frames on conn_id, from 1.

columns.name: payload
columns.description: RawMessage.payload, the venue's frame byte for byte as it came off the socket.

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: The landing batch that landed the record, its k2.batch-id.

columns.name: landed_at
columns.description: When that landing batch committed, UTC.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: The run that landed the record, <dag_id>/<run_id>.

columns.name: release_id
columns.description: The release that run resolved at its start.

outputs.purpose: One typed row per trade and delivery: each element of a bronze trade frame's data array, its symbol resolved to the security master's instrument at the trade's time. A trade the venue sent twice is two rows, the later one flagged is_duplicate. A frame is here only once every trade in it resolves; until then it is held in silver_trade_unresolved.

columns.name: kafka_partition
columns.description: The topic partition of the frame; with kafka_offset, the row's lineage to bronze_trade, the landing and the topic.

columns.name: kafka_offset
columns.description: The frame's offset in its partition.

columns.name: trade_ordinal
columns.description: The trade's position in the frame's data array, from 1 (UNNEST ... WITH ORDINALITY).

columns.name: trade_ts
columns.description: The venue's timestamp of the trade (timestamp), in UTC to the microsecond. The partition source (day), so it is in the key, as an incremental merge's unique key holds every partition source column; the first three key columns alone are already unique.

columns.name: trade_id
columns.description: The venue's trade id (trade_id), sequential per symbol.

columns.name: venue_symbol
columns.description: The symbol as the venue spells it (symbol), the security master's venue_symbol.

columns.name: instrument_id
columns.description: The security master's instrument the symbol named at trade_ts, from the version valid then.

columns.name: side
columns.description: The taker's side as the venue sends it, buy or sell.

columns.name: price
columns.description: The price in the quote asset, the venue's JSON number cast exactly to a decimal: twenty integer and eighteen fractional digits, the precision of the listing's tick_size, so a price is compared with its tick exactly and nothing the venue sends is rounded.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: The quantity in the base asset (qty), cast exactly as price is; the listing's order_min has the same precision.

columns.name: order_type
columns.description: The taker order's type as the venue sends it (ord_type), market or limit.

columns.name: frame_type
columns.description: The frame's type: snapshot, the recent trades the venue sends on subscribing, or update, trades as they happen. A snapshot repeats trades an earlier connection delivered, which is_duplicate then flags.

columns.name: is_duplicate
columns.description: True when an earlier delivery of the same trade_id for the same venue_symbol is in this table: the first delivery by (kafka_partition, kafka_offset, trade_ordinal) is the original, every later one is flagged and kept.

columns.name: received_at
columns.description: When the capture received the frame (the envelope's recv_ts_ns), in UTC, truncated to the microsecond.

columns.name: conn_id
columns.description: The capture's websocket connection that received the frame.

columns.name: conn_msg_seq
columns.description: The frame's number within that connection, from the envelope.

roles.inWords: only rows whose trade_ts is at least 20 minutes old; conn_id, conn_msg_seq, kafka_offset and received_at read as null

outputs.purpose: The held trades: every trade of a bronze trade frame that is not in silver_trade, because a trade in it has a symbol the security master resolves to nothing at the trade's time. Rebuilt on every build, so a frame leaves it on the build that moves it into silver_trade.

columns.name: kafka_partition
columns.description: The topic partition of the frame.

columns.name: kafka_offset
columns.description: The frame's offset in its partition.

columns.name: trade_ordinal
columns.description: The trade's position in the frame's data array, from 1.

columns.name: trade_ts
columns.description: The venue's timestamp of the trade, in UTC to the microsecond; the time the symbol must resolve at.

columns.name: trade_id
columns.description: The venue's trade id.

columns.name: venue_symbol
columns.description: The symbol as the venue spells it.

columns.name: side
columns.description: The taker's side as the venue sends it.

columns.name: price
columns.description: The price, cast exactly as in silver_trade.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: The quantity, cast exactly as in silver_trade.

columns.name: order_type
columns.description: The taker order's type as the venue sends it.

columns.name: frame_type
columns.description: The frame's type, snapshot or update.

columns.name: received_at
columns.description: When the capture received the frame, in UTC, truncated to the microsecond.

columns.name: conn_id
columns.description: The capture's websocket connection that received the frame.

columns.name: conn_msg_seq
columns.description: The frame's number within that connection.

quality.name: unresolved_rows_zero
quality.description: No trade is held. A held one warns: the build still publishes the rest, the run is degraded, and an instruments run is started so the master can resolve the symbol.
